kv17.4:1.3: indriyabaddhaññeva aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ viparināmadhammanti.
kv17.4:1.5: nanu anindriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭicca samuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ viparināmadhammanti.
kv17.4:1.7: hañci anindriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv17.4:2.1: indriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ
kv17.4:4.7: anindriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv17.4:5.4: yathā indriyabaddhassa dukkhassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati, evamevaṃ anindriyabaddhassa dukkhassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti.
kv17.4:5.6: yathā indriyabaddhaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññātaṃ na puna uppajjati, evamevaṃ anindriyabaddhaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññātaṃ na puna uppajjatī’ti.
